The pipeline should be compiled and fitted, and the summary of the evaluation components should be printed. The main function should accept a configuration file as an argument.

import argparse
from fate.ml.pipeline import PipelineJob
from fate.ml.pipeline.components import (
    Reader,
    DataTransform,
    Sample,
    FeatureBinning,
    OneHotEncoder,
    LogisticRegression,
    LocalBaseline,
    SecureBoost,
    Evaluation
)
from fate.ml.pipeline.interface import Data
from fate.ml.pipeline.config import PipelineConfig

def main(config_path):
    # Load pipeline config
    config = PipelineConfig.load(config_path)
    guest = config.parties.guest[0]
    host = config.parties.host[0]
    guest_train_data = config.data.guest_train
    host_train_data = config.data.host_train

    # Initialize pipeline
    pipeline = PipelineJob()
    pipeline.set_initiator(role='guest', party_id=guest)
    pipeline.set_roles(guest=guest, host=host)

    # Reader components
    reader_0 = Reader(name="reader_0")
    reader_0.get_party_instance(role='guest', party_id=guest).component_param(
        table=guest_train_data['name'], namespace=guest_train_data['namespace']
    )
    reader_0.get_party_instance(role='host', party_id=host).component_param(
        table=host_train_data['name'], namespace=host_train_data['namespace']
    )

    # DataTransform
    data_transform_0 = DataTransform(name="data_transform_0")
    data_transform_0.get_party_instance(role='guest', party_id=guest).component_param(
        with_label=True, output_format="dense"
    )
    data_transform_0.get_party_instance(role='host', party_id=host).component_param(
        with_label=False
    )

    # Sample
    sample_0 = Sample(name="sample_0")
    sample_0.get_party_instance(role='guest', party_id=guest).component_param(
        mode="random", fraction=0.8, random_state=42
    )

    # FeatureBinning
    binning_0 = FeatureBinning(name="feature_binning_0")
    binning_0.get_party_instance(role='guest', party_id=guest).component_param(
        method="quantile", compress_thres=10000, bin_num=10
    )
    binning_0.get_party_instance(role='host', party_id=host).component_param(
        method="quantile", compress_thres=10000, bin_num=10
    )

    # OneHotEncoder
    one_hot_0 = OneHotEncoder(name="one_hot_encoder_0")
    one_hot_0.get_party_instance(role='guest', party_id=guest).component_param(
        transform_col_indexes=-1
    )
    one_hot_0.get_party_instance(role='host', party_id=host).component_param(
        transform_col_indexes=-1
    )

    # Logistic Regression
    lr_0 = LogisticRegression(name="logistic_regression_0")
    lr_0.get_party_instance(role='guest', party_id=guest).component_param(
        penalty="L2", optimizer="sgd", max_iter=10, alpha=0.01, learning_rate=0.15, init_param={"init_method": "zeros"}
    )

    # Local Baseline
    local_baseline_0 = LocalBaseline(name="local_baseline_0")
    local_baseline_0.get_party_instance(role='guest', party_id=guest).component_param(
        model_type="lr"
    )

    # SecureBoost
    sbt_0 = SecureBoost(name="secure_boost_0")
    sbt_0.get_party_instance(role='guest', party_id=guest).component_param(
        num_trees=5, task_type="classification", objective_param={"objective": "cross_entropy"}, learning_rate=0.1
    )

    # Evaluation
    eval_0 = Evaluation(name="evaluation_0")
    eval_0.get_party_instance(role='guest', party_id=guest).component_param(
        eval_type="binary"
    )

    # Add components to pipeline
    pipeline.add_component(reader_0)
    pipeline.add_component(data_transform_0, data=Data(data=reader_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(sample_0, data=Data(data=data_transform_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(binning_0, data=Data(data=sample_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(one_hot_0, data=Data(data=binning_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(lr_0, data=Data(train_data=one_hot_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(local_baseline_0, data=Data(train_data=one_hot_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(sbt_0, data=Data(train_data=one_hot_0.output.data))
    pipeline.add_component(eval_0, data=Data(
        data=[lr_0.output.data, local_baseline_0.output.data, sbt_0.output.data]
    ))

    # Compile and fit pipeline
    pipeline.compile()
    pipeline.fit()

    # Print evaluation summary
    print("Evaluation Summary:")
    print(eval_0.get_summary())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Federated Learning Pipeline with FATE")
    parser.add_argument("--config", type=str, required=True, help="Path to pipeline config file")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(args.config)
```
